Subject: Quarter-end inventory controls
Summary: We are standardizing the final inventory count across all regional facilities to improve auditability and reduce reconciliation time.

Sections.Heading: What changes
Sections.Body: Cycle counts will close at 17:00 local time on September 29. All adjustments require a reason code and a second approver.

Sections.Heading: Local responsibilities
Sections.Body: Site leads must publish counting teams, isolate receiving zones, and confirm scanner readiness by September 22.

Action: Acknowledge the operating checklist in the controls portal by September 15.
